projects.title: Energy and Emission
projects.description:
Our campus has taken a major leap towards sustainability by integrating renewable energy solutions. Through solar and wind power initiatives, we significantly reduce our carbon footprint while ensuring energy efficiency. The 250kW solar power station generates an average of 34,875 units per month, resulting in an annual savings of ₹35 lakhs in electricity bills. Additionally, we procure 65,000 units of wind energy monthly to supplement solar energy, ensuring a steady power supply with minimal environmental impact.

To further enhance energy optimization, a Digital Power Monitoring System has been implemented. This system provides real-time insights into energy consumption, allowing proactive decision-making for conservation. Our campus-wide commitment to sustainable energy not only reduces reliance on non-renewable sources but also fosters a culture of eco-conscious living among students and staff.
projects.overview: Our campus embraces renewable energy with a commitment to reduce carbon emissions by utilizing solar and wind energy.
keyHighlights: Solar Energy: 250kW solar power station generating 34,875 units monthly, reducing ₹35 lakhs in annual electricity bills.
Wind Energy Procurement: 65,000 units purchased monthly to complement solar energy.
Digital Power Monitoring System: Tracks and optimizes energy use with real-time data insights.

projects.title: Waste Management
projects.description:
Waste management is a crucial part of our sustainability mission. Through our **Resource Recovery Park (RRP)**, we recover over 250 tons of resources annually by segregating more than 25 types of waste. This initiative not only promotes recycling but also generates revenue, with ₹50+ lakhs earned yearly from waste upcycling and composting. The RRP ensures that all biodegradable waste is converted into organic compost, reducing landfill contributions and improving soil quality.

Our **Sewage Treatment Plant (STP)** recycles 1 million liters of wastewater daily, making it suitable for landscape irrigation. Additionally, our **Upcycling Studio** creatively repurposes discarded materials into functional items, further emphasizing our zero-waste vision. With active student participation in waste segregation and upcycling initiatives, our waste management project fosters an environmentally responsible campus culture.
projects.overview: Microcosm’s Resource Recovery Park (RRP) drives a zero-waste future by segregating, composting, and upcycling campus waste.
keyHighlights: Resource Recovery Park: 250+ tons of resources recovered annually, 25+ waste types segregated, ₹50+ lakhs annually from waste upcycling and composting.
Sewage Treatment Plant: Recycles 1 million liters daily for landscape irrigation.
Upcycling Studio: Repurposes discarded materials into usable items.

projects.title: Water Conservation
projects.description:
Water scarcity is a growing concern, and our campus is taking proactive steps to conserve water through **rainwater harvesting**, **aerators**, and **smart water meters**. We collect approximately 8.3 million liters of rainwater annually through recharge wells and percolation ponds, significantly replenishing groundwater levels. Our aerators, installed across all hostels and restrooms, reduce water flow rates, saving nearly 30,000 liters per day without compromising usability.

Another key initiative is our **Sewage Treatment Plant (STP)**, which processes 1 million liters of wastewater daily using **MBBR technology**. This treated water is completely recycled for irrigation purposes, ensuring that no wastewater goes to waste. These measures collectively contribute to sustainable water usage while educating students about the importance of conservation.
projects.overview: Water resilience is at the core of Microcosm’s sustainability goals. We optimize water usage through rainwater harvesting, aerators, and smart water meters.
keyHighlights: Rainwater Harvesting: Captures 8.3 million liters annually through percolation ponds and recharge wells.
Aerators Installation: Saves 30,000 liters daily by reducing water flow rates in restrooms and hostels.
Sewage Treatment Plant: Treats 1 million liters daily with MBBR technology, recycling 100% for irrigation.

impactMetrics.Water saved: 10.95 million liters of water saved annually.
impactMetrics.STP: 7 lakh liters treated daily through STP

projects.title: Biodiversity Enrichment
projects.description: Biodiversity plays a crucial role in maintaining ecological balance, and our campus is dedicated to enriching it through afforestation initiatives. The Ahimsa Vanam, a one-acre urban forest, houses 150+ native species that provide a habitat for diverse flora and fauna. The initiative not only supports native biodiversity but also acts as a natural carbon sink, capable of sequestering 10,000 kg of carbon annually. Additionally, the green spaces on campus serve as a living laboratory for students and researchers, fostering awareness and conservation efforts.To further enhance afforestation, our Native Tree Nursery has successfully nurtured and distributed over 89,406 saplings across the state. These saplings are grown using hardening techniques to ensure resilience in diverse climatic conditions. Furthermore, our Honey Hives project promotes pollination, aiding plant growth while producing 20 liters of honey annually. Such efforts contribute to a healthier environment by increasing green cover, stabilizing soil, and supporting pollinators like bees and butterflies.
projects.overview: Microcosm nurtures biodiversity through tree plantations and urban forests.
keyHighlights: Ahimsa Vanam: A one-acre forest with 150 native species that sequesters 10,000 kg of carbon annually.
Native Tree Nursery: 89,406 saplings distributed for afforestation efforts.
Honey Hives: Promotes pollination, producing 20 liters of honey annually.

impactMetrics.Saplings planted: 300+ saplings planted at Chinnavedampatti Lake in collaboration with local NGOs.

projects.title: Dairy Entrepreneurship
projects.description: The Dairy Entrepreneurship project aims to revolutionize dairy farming by integrating climate-smart and sustainable practices. Through financial and technological support, we assist 100+ entrepreneurs in adopting improved cattle management and milk production techniques. With a $4 lakh grant, the initiative facilitates training programs, equipment support, and research on dairy sustainability. These advancements not only enhance dairy production but also contribute to the livelihood of 10,000+ farmers by improving their economic stability.In addition to economic support, we collaborate with 10+ stakeholders to implement innovative dairy management solutions. The program includes cattle health optimization, waste management, and sustainable feed alternatives to ensure eco-friendly dairy production. Moreover, 300+ household surveys have been conducted across six districts, providing valuable insights into traditional and modern dairy practices. The project ultimately aims to bridge the gap between sustainability and rural entrepreneurship, empowering local dairy farmers.
projects.overview: Microcosm’s Climate-Smart Dairy initiative empowers dairy entrepreneurs through education, funding, and technological innovation.
keyHighlights: $4 lakh grant for developing sustainable dairy practices.
Partnerships with 10+ stakeholders to optimize cattle health and milk production.

projects.title: Sustainability Education
projects.description: Education is a powerful tool for fostering sustainability, and we actively engage students through immersive climate awareness programs. Our Y20 Climate Talks have involved 200+ students in global discussions on pressing environmental issues. Through interactive workshops, we emphasize the importance of conservation, renewable energy, and responsible consumption, equipping the next generation with the knowledge to lead sustainable initiatives.Furthermore, our National Green Corps Literacy Camp has trained 60+ students in climate literacy, enabling them to advocate for environmental change. In addition, our Campus Sustainability Tours have impacted 2,000+ students from 40+ schools, providing hands-on learning experiences about green campus initiatives, waste management, and energy conservation. These efforts ensure that sustainability is not just a concept but a practice deeply ingrained in future leaders.
projects.overview: We cultivate future leaders through sustainability workshops, campus tours, and hands-on projects.
keyHighlights: Y20 Climate Talks: 200+ students engaged in global climate discussions.
National Green Corps Literacy Camp: 60+ students trained in climate literacy.
Campus Sustainability Tours: Impacted 2000+ students from 40+ schools.
